intro: A multidisciplinary toolkit shaped by real product work—from structuring complex systems and designing interfaces to supporting implementation and creating visual experiences beyond the screen.
applicationNote: SKILLS ARE SHOWN THROUGH APPLICATION, NOT PERCENTAGES.

capabilities.title: PRODUCT THINKING
capabilities.description: Turning requirements, business goals, and user needs into clear product direction and structured digital flows.

capabilities.title: INTERFACE SYSTEMS
capabilities.description: Designing responsive, scalable interfaces with clear hierarchy, reusable patterns, and consistent visual language.

capabilities.title: VALIDATION & DELIVERY
capabilities.description: Testing decisions through prototypes, aligning with stakeholders, and supporting teams through handoff and UAT.

toolsDescription: Tools support the process—the thinking and decisions come first.
